items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: he was the brother to Lee Collins, who was from the Collins family, very, very popular, well known jazz family in New Orleans

ctx.x: The personnel consisted of a -- let's see, there were brothers, there were two brothers from Texas, Leo Williams and Eddie Williams. Leo played trombone. Eddie Williams played bass violin, and then we had Al Wilson, who was a marvelous saxophonist and arranger. And he taught me, I studied arranging under him. Yes, he had me arranging for the big Southern Rhythm Boys Orchestra for a while. And also in that orchestra was Alexis Rochan and Shelly LeMelle from New Orleans, and also a John Collins, I think that's the…
And both John and Lee played trumpet, is that right?
